remarks: Refined living meets everyday convenience in this beautifully maintained rare 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath townhouse with a versatile 3rd floor offering an ideal third bedroom plus an office, located in the highly desirable River's Edge complex on the Darien/New Canaan border. The main level features hardwood floors, a spacious open-concept living and dining area, and an eat-in kitchen appointed with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances. Sliders lead to a private balcony, perfect for relaxing outdoors. The primary suite is a true retreat, showcasing cathedral ceilings, oversized windows, and a large walk-in closet with custom shelving. Tastefully designed second bedroom features shiplap accent wall & custom window treatments throughout. The upper-level provides exceptional flexibility to suit a variety of lifestyle needs including a 3rd bedroom and an office nook. Additional highlights include a stunning laundry room, abundant storage, and an attached garage. Enjoy resort-style amenities including a pool, fitness center, and newly renovated clubhouse. Ideally situated in Springdale Village, this home offers walk-to-everything convenience-Springdale train, restaurants, shops, parks, library, and more-while remaining just 1.5 miles to golf, 2 miles to the Merritt Parkway, and 3 miles to I-95. A rare opportunity to move right into one of the area's most sought-after communities.
